The [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] had a secret '''insurgent camp''' in [[Sector S-29/Legends|sector S-29]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the rebels called the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to help them retake [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. This camp also used for training for the rebels when the Jedi arrived but the recon droids located the camp and a [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|small battle]] occurred there.
